scope: Classic VERTEX_2D tangent direction only. The public tgdir field follows the existing DXF group-50 and LibreCAD contract (degrees); DWG BD tangent is converted to/from radians. No DXF code, 3D/mesh/polyface codec, or class layout is changed. Pre-R13 dwgreaderR11 has a separate tangent path and is not qualified.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.11 lists the VERTEX_2D tangent BD and DXF group 50; it does not explicitly state its angular units in that field listing. Producer and independent readback establish the units for these witnesses. LibreCAD bundled DRW_Vertex::parseCode and dxfRW::writePolyline preserve DXF group 50 in degrees.

generated: Scratch author.cpp creates AC1021 model-space 2D polyline with first vertex flags=2, tgdir=45, and enables existing material/plotstyle graph opt-ins. Old build output DWG SHA fab3b11e1b86b72b15f772790c3fad3e00424f8b20f0bc72358161444e36fcc7 contains 45 rad and ODA DXF SHA f73343f6fc05628d07f444acf2fbd2e8ea8b8449168e48f7160d3a35f848c9fb reports 2578.310078088705 degrees. Corrected output DWG SHA c87eccf2dd235c3fb0b89bf6833f3daaadfd3fd4c88638ba95f5564f284c1c1a contains pi/4 rad and ODA DXF SHA 160a3d5301ce8df561f444432d5cd88ba0e2373011db9a015aeba10ef7c9396f reports 45 degrees. ODA lineage is the recorded scratch command, not proven by the hash gate alone. Both selected DXFs contain three vertices; audit.py checks hashes, flags and angles with LibreDWG and DXF tags.
validation: Scratch test.cpp links corrected library and passes AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 native writer/reader checks for 45, -60 and flag-clear 20-degree retained BD; AC1021 literal scalar parses pi/4, fails against old library, then tests truncation/reset/retry. 3D subtype bytes are unchanged; nonfinite, zero-rounded and subnormal-radian inputs refuse with direct buffer preservation, followed by successful retry. A whole-file failure preserves sentinel and corrected retry succeeds. The existing AC1015 bounded facade refuses flag-2 tangent; a scratch copy of its legacy test with flag=0 and 45-degree retained tangent passes, and LibreDWG observes pi/4 in generated DWG SHA eba5305ccef8670c1d62fd4e649252474872becf83099837512113e57a787f0e. Only a physical flagged AC1015 reader is qualified.
limits: The public unit correction changes the observable tgdir of DWG callbacks; consumers that compensated for the old raw-radian behavior must remove that compensation. No complete-file interoperability or pre-R13 claim. A flag-clear stored tangent is preserved in DWG but DXF output only emits group 50 when flag 2 is set, following existing behavior. Corrected artifacts were produced by an isolated scratch build; the baseline used the existing shared build. The rounded ODA DXF observations do not prove other angular values or untested producers. Extremely small nonzero tangents whose radians become zero or subnormal are conservatively refused; such values cannot retain meaningful precision in the DWG double.
